name: komodo_mouth_teeth
description: Close-up of a Komodo dragon's mouth, facing right: front half of the head very large, jaws open about 20 degrees, dark #7a0d0d mouth interior, rows of cream curved, flattened, serrated teeth (tiny notches on the back edge, tips curving back toward the throat) partly sheathed in grey-pink gum. No red on the teeth, no blood. Small hard amber eye under a heavy brow. Anchor centre, ~980x500 (x -530..446, y -250..252). The left end is a soft, darker scaly neck fade like komodo_head (lumpy scale edge, dark spray, no outline, closed jaw corner), so no straight cut shows when it is not bled off-frame.
